pack.name: Organization security architecture starter
pack.description: A parameterized starter for organization-defined security architecture policy. Replace every {{organization.*}} placeholder before creating the pack.

rules.title: Approved regions
rules.description: Production resources must remain in {{organization.allowedRegions}} unless an approved exception is recorded.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.allowedRegions}} with the approved region list and document exception ownership.

rules.title: Region exception process
rules.description: Resources outside {{organization.allowedRegions}} require an accountable owner, business reason, and expiry date.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.allowedRegions}} and define the evidence required for region exceptions.

rules.title: Approved cloud services
rules.description: Production workloads may use only services in {{organization.approvedServices}} unless a security architect approves an exception.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.approvedServices}} with the approved service list and identify the exception approver.

rules.title: Service approval lifecycle
rules.description: New services in {{organization.approvedServices}} must have an owner, intended data use, and review date before production deployment.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.approvedServices}} and record the service approval lifecycle in policy constraints.

rules.title: Network boundary standard
rules.description: Workloads must follow {{organization.networkBoundary}} for ingress, egress, private connectivity, and trust-zone separation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.networkBoundary}} with the organization network boundary standard and its exception path.

rules.title: Network exception evidence
rules.description: Any deviation from {{organization.networkBoundary}} must identify the compensating control, owner, and expiry.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.networkBoundary}} and define how network exceptions are reviewed and retired.

rules.title: Identity baseline
rules.description: Human and workload access must follow {{organization.identityRequirements}}, including authentication, authorization, and lifecycle ownership.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.identityRequirements}} with the required identity baseline and evidence expectations.

rules.title: Privileged identity review
rules.description: Privileged access governed by {{organization.identityRequirements}} must be time-bound, reviewed, and monitored for emergency use.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.identityRequirements}} and specify the privileged-access review cadence.

rules.title: Data classification handling
rules.description: Data stores and flows must apply {{organization.dataClassificationPolicy}} to access, encryption, retention, and monitoring decisions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.dataClassificationPolicy}} with the approved classification and handling standard.

rules.title: Data classification exceptions
rules.description: Data that cannot follow {{organization.dataClassificationPolicy}} requires documented risk acceptance and a removal date.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.dataClassificationPolicy}} and identify the required exception evidence.

rules.title: Required resource tags
rules.description: Resources must carry {{organization.requiredTags}} so ownership, environment, data class, and lifecycle are reviewable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.requiredTags}} with the required tag keys and values or approved tag policy.

rules.title: Tag enforcement and exceptions
rules.description: Missing or conflicting {{organization.requiredTags}} must block or generate an owned exception with an expiry date.
rules.remediationGuidance: Replace {{organization.requiredTags}} and define the enforcement and exception workflow.
